message: Yeah. The 24th ID, in Savannah, deployed when [Andrew](http://www.noaa.gov/hurricaneandrew.html) slammed into south Florida. Of course, the 24th has since reflagged as the 3rd, and it's kind of hard to lend any help from Iraq. And then there's the problem that Georgia National Guard frequently borrowed our equipment for civil missions, and that equipment's in Iraq, too. But that really doesn't make much difference either, because the Georgia National Guard's 48th BCT is in Iraq, as well.
